commands:
set -eu
repo=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
worktree=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
branch=fix/macbook-trackpad-zoom
expected=91334a76de1e8d239c68dff9c29002847a6c5097
test -d "$repo"
git -C "$repo" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree | grep -qx true
test "$(git -C "$repo" remote get-url origin)" = "https://github.com/MichalMatu/photomap.git"
test -z "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1)"
printf 'AGENT_WORK_BEFORE=%s %s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)" "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
git -C "$repo" fetch --no-tags origin "refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main" "refs/heads/$branch:refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
actual=$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
printf 'ZOOM_REMOTE_SHA=%s\n' "$actual"
test "$actual" = "$expected"
if test -e "$worktree"; then
  test -d "$worktree"
  test "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$worktree"
  test "$(git -C "$worktree" branch --show-current)" = "$branch"
  test -z "$(git -C "$worktree" status --porcelain=v1)"
  git -C "$worktree" merge --ff-only "refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
else
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$worktree")"
  if git -C "$repo" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$branch"; then
    git -C "$repo" worktree add "$worktree" "$branch"
    git -C "$worktree" merge --ff-only "refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
  else
    git -C "$repo" worktree add -b "$branch" "$worktree" "refs/remotes/origin/$branch"
  fi
fi
test "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected"
test -z "$(git -C "$worktree" status --porcelain=v1)"
printf 'ZOOM_WORKTREE=%s\n' "$worktree"
printf 'ZOOM_WORKTREE_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C "$worktree" branch --show-current)"
printf 'ZOOM_WORKTREE_SHA=%s\n' "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'NODE=%s\n' "$(node --version 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
printf 'NPM=%s\n' "$(npm --version 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
printf 'PYTHON=%s\n' "$(python3 --version 2>&1 || echo missing)"
for p in "$repo/frontend/node_modules/.bin/vite" "$repo/backend/.venv/bin/python" "$worktree/frontend/node_modules/.bin/vite" "$worktree/backend/.venv/bin/python"; do
  if test -x "$p"; then printf 'DEP_OK=%s\n' "$p"; else printf 'DEP_MISSING=%s\n' "$p"; fi
done
for port in 8000 5174 18001 15175; do
  if lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then printf 'PORT_BUSY=%s\n' "$port"; else printf 'PORT_FREE=%s\n' "$port"; fi
done
for p in "$repo/backend/data/app.db" "$worktree/backend/data/app.db"; do
  if test -f "$p"; then printf 'LOCAL_DB_PRESENT=%s\n' "$p"; else printf 'LOCAL_DB_ABSENT=%s\n' "$p"; fi
done
printf 'AGENT_WORK_AFTER=%s %s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)" "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'AGENT_WORK_DIRTY=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo PHOTOMAP_MAC_ZOOM_WORKTREE_SETUP_COMPLETE
